description: Hungarian cooking centers on paprika, noodles, and sour cream. Technique-driven cooking — fond, butter, wine reductions, and respect for seasonal produce.

attributes.micro_lesson: Build depth with fond from searing, reduce wine and stock, finish with cold butter for shine.
attributes.shopping_tip: Keep mirepoix components, good butter, and wine vinegar on hand.
flavor_building: Start with sour cream as your cooking medium.
Season with paprika — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around noodles as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Hungarian food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
